Table has exactly 3 data rows (GOLD, SILVER, BRONZE)
assertions.evidence: Gold customer | GOLD | 20 / Silver customer | SILVER | 10 / Bronze customer | BRONZE | 0

assertions.text: Test method body contains only one assertEquals (or equivalent assertion) — not three
Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: Method body contains only the single assertEquals with no conditional logic

assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
assertions.evidence: Scenario | Customer tier | Discount? (Scenario is first column)

assertions.text: Test method has either a @DisplayName annotation or a method name that reads as a clear, descriptive title when converted from camelCase/snake_case
assertions.evidence: void returnsDiscountByTier(...) (converts to 'Returns Discount By Tier')

assertions.text: If @Description is present, it provides context beyond what the table rows already express

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName (if present), @Description (if present), @TableTest
